nodes.label: SS2VR Weapon Aim & Model Pinning Architecture
nodes.rationale: The controller ray is the single source of truth. Pin the bullet, the model, and the muzzle to it while leaving KEX's camera/view alone.

nodes.label: Stage A: Projectile Redirect
nodes.rationale: Functional aim achieved by redirecting fired projectiles along the controller ray using a deferred Squirrel script pass.

nodes.label: Stage B: Model & Muzzle Pinning
nodes.rationale: Visual alignment achieved by driving the viewmodel rig (aimPoint) from the controller pose in the Squirrel layer.

nodes.label: ss2vr_aim Config Variable
nodes.rationale: A space-separated string published by the DLL containing controller pose data (camera-local and world-space) for Squirrel consumption.

nodes.label: SS2VRShootAimScript
nodes.rationale: Squirrel script attached to projectile archetypes to handle immediate and deferred (one-shot timer) re-aiming.

nodes.label: NDShockGunViewmodel.OnFrameUpdate
nodes.rationale: Target for class patching to drive the 'aimPoint' rig from controller data, ensuring model and muzzle flash coherence.
